title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion in Cambridge Analytica Case
excerpt: Meta has been ordered to pay a $25 billion payout following a trial centered on its data privacy practices and the Cambridge Analytica scandal.
body_html:
Meta has been ordered to pay a massive financial penalty following a recent trial. The legal case centered on the social media giant's data privacy practices and is connected to the Cambridge Analytica scandal.

According to the details, the court ordered a payout of $25 billion. The trial examined how the company handled user data and privacy issues stemming from the high-profile controversy.
